_items.heading:
Start with
what you notice.
_items.body: Slow down long enough to see the situation clearly. What is happening, and what might you be missing?

_items.heading:
Ask what it
really means.
_items.body: Turn what you noticed into a question worth answering. A good question narrows the problem down.

_items.heading:
Try it against
the evidence.
_items.body: Weigh your idea against what you can actually show. Keep what holds up; drop what does not.

_items.heading:
Carry it into
your own work.
_items.body: Decide what this changes for the task in front of you, and do that next.
